1-generalizado
```{r setup DARA RData}
files <- c(
  "malaria_2016.RData",
  "malaria_2017.RData",
  "malaria_2018.RData",
  "malaria_2019.RData"
)

datasets <- lapply(files, function(file){

  objs <- load(
    file.path("~/pratica-pesquisa/DARA/datasets-malaria", file)
  )

  get(objs[1])

})

malaria <- bind_rows(datasets)

save(
  malaria,
  file = "dataset.RData"
)
```

```{r config}
# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURAÇÃO — editar apenas este bloco para usar com qualquer dataset
# =============================================================================

INPUT_FILE     <- "dataset.RData"

SELECTED_COLS  <- NULL # descomentar para usar todas as colunas

RHS_TARGET     <- "exam.result=vivax"   
RHS_ATTR      <- "exam.result"
RHS_VALUE     <- "vivax"

APRIORI_SUPP  <- 0.05
APRIORI_CONF  <- 0.8
APRIORI_MINLEN <- 3
APRIORI_MAXLEN <- 4

MIN_LIFT       <- 1
MIN_COUNT      <- 1

OUTPUT_FILE    <- "malaria-rules-g5.RData"
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(arules)
  library(arulesViz)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
})

resolve_path <- function(fname) {
  if (file.exists(fname)) return(fname)
  p <- file.path("dara", fname)
  if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  stop(sprintf("Arquivo não encontrado: %s", fname))
}

rhs_column <- function(rhs_target) sub("=.*", "", rhs_target)
```

```{r load-data}
#raw <- read_csv(resolve_path(INPUT_FILE), show_col_types = FALSE)
#load(resolve_path(INPUT_FILE))

# Carrega arquivo .RData
input_path <- resolve_path(INPUT_FILE)

loaded_objects <- load(input_path)

if (length(loaded_objects) == 0) {
  stop("O arquivo .RData não contém nenhum objeto.")
}

# Usa o primeiro objeto carregado como dataset
raw <- get(loaded_objects[1])

if (!is.data.frame(raw)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "O objeto carregado (%s) não é um data.frame.",
    loaded_objects[1]
  ))
}

if (!is.null(SELECTED_COLS)) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(SELECTED_COLS, names(raw))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0)
    stop(sprintf("Colunas não encontradas: %s", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  data <- subset(raw, select = SELECTED_COLS)
} else {
  data <- raw
}

message(sprintf("Dataset carregado: %d linhas x %d colunas", nrow(data), ncol(data)))
```

```{r generate-rules}
pf_data <- data.frame(lapply(data, as.factor))

rules <- apriori(
  pf_data,
  parameter = list(supp = APRIORI_SUPP, conf = APRIORI_CONF,
                   minlen = APRIORI_MINLEN, maxlen = APRIORI_MAXLEN, target = "rules"),
  appearance = list(rhs = RHS_TARGET),
  control    = list(verbose = FALSE)
)
message(sprintf("Regras geradas: %d", length(rules)))
```

```{r filter-rules}
imrules <- interestMeasure(rules, transactions = pf_data)
rules   <- rules[imrules$lift >= MIN_LIFT & imrules$count > MIN_COUNT]
message(sprintf("Após filtro lift & count: %d", length(rules)))

rules <- rules[!is.redundant(rules)]
message(sprintf("Após remoção de redundâncias: %d", length(rules)))
```

```{r build-dataset}
imrules <- interestMeasure(rules, transactions = pf_data)
dataset <- as(rules, "data.frame")
rhs_col <- rhs_column(RHS_TARGET)

if (length(rules) > 0) {
  splitted <- str_split(dataset$rules, " => ", simplify = TRUE)
  dataset  <- data.frame(
    lhs = splitted[, 1], rhs = gsub(paste0(rhs_col, "="), "", splitted[, 2]),
    support = dataset$support, confidence = dataset$confidence,
    lift = imrules$lift, count = imrules$count,
    kulc = imrules$kulczynski, ir = imrules$imbalance,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (col in c("lhs", "rhs")) dataset[[col]] <- gsub("[{}]", "", dataset[[col]])
  for (nm in names(data)) dataset[[nm]] <- NA

  lhs_items <- str_split(dataset$lhs, ",")
  for (i in seq_along(lhs_items)) {
    for (kv in lhs_items[[i]]) {
      nv <- str_split(trimws(kv), "=", simplify = TRUE)
      if (ncol(nv) == 2) {
        col_name <- trimws(nv[1, 1])
        if (col_name %in% names(dataset)) dataset[i, col_name] <- trimws(nv[1, 2])
      }
    }
  }

  for (nc in c("lift","count","confidence","support","kulc","ir"))
    dataset[[nc]] <- as.numeric(dataset[[nc]])
}
```

```{r save-output}
out_path <- OUTPUT_FILE
#write.csv(dataset, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE)
#save(dataset, file = out_path)

save(
  dataset,
  file = out_path
)

message(sprintf(
  "Arquivo de regras salvo em: %s (%d linhas)",
  out_path,
  nrow(dataset)
))

#message(sprintf("Salvo em: %s (%d linhas)", out_path, nrow(dataset)))
```

```{r setup DARA RData}
# Load categorized dataset

#malaria <- load_rdata(resolve_path("dataset.RData"))
files <- c(
  "malaria_2016.RData",
  "malaria_2017.RData",
  "malaria_2018.RData",
  "malaria_2019.RData"
)

datasets <- lapply(files, function(file){

  objs <- load(
    file.path("~/pratica-pesquisa/DARA/datasets_lais", file)
  )

  get(objs[1])

})

malaria <- bind_rows(datasets)

save(
  malaria,
  file = "dataset_lais.RData"
)
names(malaria)
```

```{r generate-rules}
# Helper to resolve a file that may be in CWD or under dara/
resolve_path <- function(fname) {
  if (file.exists(fname)) return(fname)
  p <- file.path("dara", fname)
  if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  stop(sprintf("File not found: %s", fname))
}

# Select attributes of interest
data <- subset(malaria, select = c(names(malaria)) )

# Transform to factors
pf_data <- data.frame(lapply(data, as.factor))

# Generate association rules targeting tmn.geral=alto
rules_lais <- apriori(
  pf_data,
  parameter = list(supp = 0.1, conf = 0.8, minlen = 3, maxlen = 4, target = "rules"),
  appearance = list(rhs = "exam.result=vivax"),
  control = list(verbose = FALSE)
)

message(sprintf("Number of rules: %d", length(rules_lais)))

# Compute interest measures and filter
imrules <- interestMeasure(rules_lais, transactions = data)
rules_lais <- rules_lais[imrules$lift >= 1 & imrules$count > 1]
message(sprintf("Number of rules (filtering lift & count): %d", length(rules_lais)))
rules_lais <- rules_lais[!is.redundant(rules_lais)]
message(sprintf("Number of rules (after redundancy filter): %d", length(rules_lais)))

# Convert to data.frame with interest measures
imrules <- interestMeasure(rules_lais, transactions = data)
dataset_lais <- as(rules_lais, "data.frame")
df_regras <- as(rules_lais, "data.frame")

# FORÇA O RESET DOS ÍNDICES (corrige o desalinhamento do split)
rownames(dataset_lais) <- NULL

if (length(rules_lais) > 0) {
  # Divide a coluna 'rules' em duas colunas sem depender de rownames
  splitted <- str_split(df_regras$rules, " => ", simplify = TRUE)
  
  # Split lhs/rhs and normalize RHS label for downstream matching
  splitted <- str_split(dataset_lais$rules, " => ", simplify = TRUE)
  dataset_lais <- data.frame(
    lhs = splitted[, 1],
    rhs = gsub("_", "=", gsub("exam.result=", "", splitted[, 2])),
    support = dataset_lais$support,
    confidence = dataset_lais$confidence,
    lift = imrules$lift,
    count = imrules$count,
    kulc = imrules$kulczynski,
    ir = imrules$imbalance,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Clean braces
dataset_lais$rhs <- gsub("\\{", "", dataset_lais$rhs)
dataset_lais$rhs <- gsub("\\}", "", dataset_lais$rhs)
dataset_lais$lhs <- gsub("\\{", "", dataset_lais$lhs)
dataset_lais$lhs <- gsub("\\}", "", dataset_lais$lhs)

# Recreate original attribute columns present in data for easier joins later
for (nm in names(data)) dataset_lais[[nm]] <- NA

# Fill attribute columns according to LHS items
lhs_items <- str_split(dataset_lais$lhs, ",")
for (i in seq_along(lhs_items)) {
  kvs <- lhs_items[[i]]
  for (kv in kvs) {
    nv <- str_split(kv, "=", simplify = TRUE)
    if (ncol(nv) == 2) {
      dataset_lais[i, trimws(nv[1, 1])] <- trimws(nv[1, 2])
    }
  }
}

# Convert interest measures to numeric explicitly
num_cols <- c("lift","count","confidence","support","kulc","ir")
for (nc in num_cols) dataset_lais[[nc]] <- as.numeric(dataset_lais[[nc]])

# Save to dara/dataset.csv
#out_path <- resolve_path("malaria.csv")
#write.csv(dataset, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE)
#message(sprintf("Saved rules dataset to %s", out_path))

out_path <- "malaria-rules-lais.RData"

save(
  dataset_lais,
  file = out_path
)

message(sprintf(
  "Arquivo de regras salvo em: %s (%d linhas)",
  out_path,
  nrow(dataset_lais)
))
```

```{r grafico-qtd_regras-dts_malaria}
# Plotagem do gráfico de evolução temporal dos tipos de malária
# 1. Criar um data frame estruturado com os dados
df_plot <- data.frame(
  Arquivo = c("generate-rules.Rmd", "1-generalizado.Rmd"),
  Num_Regras = c(nrow(dataset_lais), nrow(dataset))
)

# 2. Plotar o gráfico usando geom_col
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Arquivo, y = Num_Regras, fill = Arquivo)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribuição dos resultados em geração de regras (dts dataset.RData)",
    x = "Arquivo",
    y = "Número de regras"
  ) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )
```
